Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, including drivers new to roundabouts and diverging diamond interchanges.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the manual lists exact places where passing is never allowed and how to yield in a roundabout [A01], and it gives step-by-step parking techniques a new driver must practice [A03].
Level: practical recall of distances and yield rules, plus ordered steps for backing, parallel parking and hill parking; the wheel directions are easy to confuse.
Prerequisites: the passing and signaling pages that precede this section.
